generic.summary: AI/ML and Generative AI Engineer with a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering and 7+ years of experience developing data-driven systems across enterprise, industry, and research environments. Experience includes LLM-enabled analytics, AI-ready data pipelines, domain-adaptive machine learning, and scalable cloud solutions using Python, SQL, Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, and Azure services. At AT&T, lead development and operational integration of AI solutions for critical service-assurance workflows, improving automated diagnostic accuracy from 20% to 80%. Combine model evaluation, data quality, ETL, and cross-functional delivery to translate technical requirements into production-oriented AI capabilities. bullets: Own end-to-end development, testing, and operational integration of an AI-driven diagnostic system for critical E911 service-assurance workflows, improving automated root-cause classification accuracy from 20% to 80%.

Designed domain-adaptive neural models and reusable data-processing workflows that generalize across heterogeneous operational domains and reduce performance degradation caused by distribution shifts.
Developed multimodal AI prototypes combining work-order text, location information, network context, and operational signals to support GenAI-assisted diagnostics for VoNR and 5G service assurance.
Created model-validation, error-analysis, and failure-mode assessment procedures to compare performance across domains and support reliable deployment in high-impact operational environments.
Partnered with network engineers, software teams, and public-safety stakeholders to translate operational requirements into validated AI workflows and production-oriented data assets.
Built an LLM-enabled analytical pipeline for extracting and interpreting information from geochemical well data.
Developed scalable ingestion, cleansing, transformation, and validation workflows using Python, Azure Databricks, Azure Functions, and Synapse Analytics.
Automated ETL processing for large exploration datasets, reducing data-preparation time by 40% and improving reproducibility.
Implemented cross-validation, data-quality, and consistency checks that improved reliability of analytical outputs by 20%.
Collaborated with geologists to convert domain requirements and technical information into AI-ready datasets and actionable analytical outputs.
Designed reusable Python simulation and data-generation platforms for large-scale experimentation, including a 3GPP-compliant network simulator and an AI-enabled 5G testbed.
Built transfer-learning, adversarial-learning, GAN, autoencoder, and reinforcement-learning pipelines for sparse-data and cross-domain modeling.
Developed robustness evaluation frameworks for models operating under distribution shifts, missing data, and limited labeled samples; led 100+ experiments from problem formulation through validation.
Developed scalable self-healing and outage-management frameworks that improved modeled network resilience by 30%.
Published peer-reviewed research, presented technical results internationally, and mentored junior researchers in ML implementation, experimental design, and technical writing.
Analyzed 500K+ LTE/5G-NR diagnostic logs and applied ML methods to detect anomalies, reducing diagnostic time by 20%.
Investigated 5G NR-NTN cell-selection behavior and improved decision algorithms by 15% through data-driven analysis and validation.
Conducted structured analysis of large operational datasets and communicated technical findings to engineering teams supporting next-generation wireless systems.
Improved autoencoder-based channel-state-information compression by 25% using transfer learning and systematic experimentation on large wireless datasets.
Conducted 50+ experiments to validate model performance, robustness, and generalization under changing data conditions.
Collaborated with research and engineering stakeholders to translate modeling results into recommendations for next-generation communication systems.
Designed ML and statistical methods for analyzing users' timing in 5G standalone networks, improving analytical precision by 20%.
Analyzed large-scale user trace data with SQL and visualization tools and communicated findings to senior technical leadership.
Converted raw operational traces into interpretable performance indicators to support diagnosis and network optimization.
